blurb: Guests rent SeaDoo jet skis to ride on Lake Sammamish. Rentals include safety and operational orientations, with staff on site for events. Event packages offer multiple jet skis and paddleboards with staff facilitation for groups and corporate picnics.
extraNote: Late fees $5 per minute first 15 minutes, then $100 plus $5 per minute, after 30 minutes double next rental rate, after 1 hour day rate · No rental credit for weather unless deemed unsafe by manager · Full refund if canceled more than 7 days before rental start, no refunds or reschedules if less than 7 days · Vasa Park on Lake Sammamish

quotes.author: Dylan Martell
quotes.text: Came here with my cousins. It was an amazing experience especially as a first timer on the jet skis. The staff were super helpful and explained everything to do. Felt super safe on the jet skis and it was super fun with awesome views from the middle of the lake.

quotes.author: Malia Brown
quotes.text: My cousin and I came here to jet ski for about an hour and we both were inexperienced but the instructors did a great job explaining everything! We had so much fun and will be coming back!!
